tex_content.html:
Remark
[Interpretation of the two cases] ↗ thm:riemann-problem-solution 1. ch3:3.4.4-rem-1\group Conservation Laws

The first case is a constant-speed shock and the second a centered rarefaction. Both coincide with the Lax--Oleinik construction by uniqueness.
